description: Set which development zone IDs are active for this workspace (stored as activeZones in .cpfs/config-mcp.json). The active zones determine the default TARGET FILES for new features. Returns the zone summary. Parity with the extension's manageActiveZones command (quick-pick → MCP args).

zone_ids.description: Zone IDs to activate (must exist in the zone map).

name: cpfs_manage_active_zones
